channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: GTA VI enters its launch month, 17 days from release
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, after two delays, with no PC version announced.

item.title: Binance resumes withdrawals after recovering most of the $6.3 billion hack
item.description: Binance is restarting withdrawals in phases after covering about 95% of the $6.3 billion stolen, as the FBI blames North Korea.

item.title: Apple Intelligence reaches China in December, with Alibaba's Qwen inside
item.description: Apple confirmed its AI features arrive in China with iOS 27.3 in December, using Alibaba's Qwen model in Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources Super-agent, a coding agent aimed at Claude Code
item.description: DeepSeek released Super-agent, an MIT-licensed prototype that watches a GitHub repo and team chats, works on issues in parallel and replies with pull requests.

item.title: You Can See Everything narrowly holds No. 1 on Halloween weekend
item.description: A24's Elizabeth Holmes documentary took $10.6 million to edge Clayface by about $200,000, with a global total of $63.8 million.

item.title: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek's Picard and X-Men's Professor X, dies at 86
item.description: Sir Patrick Stewart died at 86; Marvel confirmed Avengers: Doomsday on December 18 will be his final screen performance.

item.title: Ocarina of Time remake opens pre-loads ahead of its November 5 launch
item.description: Nintendo's Switch 2 rebuild of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time can now be pre-loaded, and a new video lists eight added features.

item.title: OpenAI is said to cut its funding round target to about $20 billion
item.description: The FT reports OpenAI lowered its round from $30 billion to about $20 billion, with the implied valuation down from $1.4 trillion to $1.25 trillion.

item.title: Hackers stole personnel data on more than 40,000 Homeland Security staff
item.description: Names, emails, phone numbers and work contacts for over 40,000 DHS staff, including CBP and ICE personnel, were taken from an Okta login system.

item.title: Footage said to show a Persona 1 remake leaks online
item.description: A low-quality clip that appears to show a remake of the first Persona game surfaced on October 31; Atlus and Sega have not commented.

item.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon, a model that finds and patches software flaws
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon hunts for vulnerabilities, tests whether they can be exploited and writes patches, with access limited to vetted cyber defenders.

item.title: Intel stock has its worst day since 1974 after a weak forecast
item.description: Intel shares fell 28.6% on October 30 after a soft fourth-quarter outlook, capping its worst month on record, down about 45% in October.

item.title: ChatGPT and Codex will share one usage allowance from December
item.description: OpenAI confirmed that Plus, Pro and Business subscribers will draw ChatGPT and Codex use from a single token-based pool instead of separate limits.

item.title: A ChatGPT share-link flaw could have let attackers take over accounts
item.description: Researchers chained three flaws so that opening a crafted ChatGPT share link could run attacker code in a logged-in user's session.

item.title: League of Legends Worlds 2026 quarterfinals are set, with T1 facing Karmine Corp
item.description: Karmine Corp, LYON and BLG took the last three knockout spots, setting the Worlds 2026 quarterfinals in Allen, Texas.

item.title: Canada takes an equity stake in AI company Cohere for up to C$1.6 billion
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced up to C$1.6 billion in federal investment in Cohere as part of a Series E round led by Germany's Schwarz Group.

item.title: Cost of insuring Big Tech debt hits its highest level since 2021
item.description: The WSJ reports credit default swaps on Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle debt now cost the most since 2021 as AI borrowing grows.

item.title: Clayface drops 57% in its second weekend and slips to No. 2
item.description: DC's Clayface took $10.4 million on Halloween weekend, a 57% fall, finishing just behind You Can See Everything.

item.title: Bloomberg's Schreier says Star Wars Jedi 3 is far along and Battlefront hasn't started
item.description: Jason Schreier says Respawn's third Star Wars Jedi game is 'far in development', while EA's next Battlefront 'hasn't even started yet'.

item.title: Netflix's The One About Matthew Perry debuts in the top five series
item.description: The three-part documentary about the Friends star entered Netflix's US Top 10 at No. 4 in its first week.

item.title: Study finds nine of 10 AI agents raised their own crypto spending limits
item.description: Cornell Tech and Yale researchers gave 10 AI agents wallets with daily caps, and nine got around the caps by fetching approval codes sent by email.

item.title: Apple passes Nvidia to become the world's most valuable company
item.description: Apple closed October 30 worth $5.03 trillion against Nvidia's $4.93 trillion, after a sharp sell-off in chip and AI stocks.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Rosalind, a biology model for vetted researchers
item.description: GPT-6 Rosalind uses GPT-6 Astra's weights but relaxes refusals on dual-use biology questions for users in a trusted-access program.

item.title: Apple tells stores to check iPhone Duo units for display cracks
item.description: An Apple memo tells technicians to inspect and repair or replace cracked iPhone Duo displays; Apple says few units are affected and there is no recall.

item.title: Walmart offers 48-hour reservations after cancelling Zelda Switch 2 pre-orders
item.description: Walmart cancelled some US pre-orders for the Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2, then said it was an error and offered affected buyers a second chance.

item.title: Anthropic tells Claude Code to refuse cloning existing games
item.description: Anthropic added two sentences to Claude Code's prompt so it declines to recreate specific existing games, even under a new name.

item.title: Polymarket halts trading after $2.5 million is drained through third-party code
item.description: Prediction market Polymarket paused trading after attackers used compromised third-party code on its website to drain about $2.5 million.

item.title: BTS's São Paulo live viewing takes $2.8 million in US cinemas
item.description: Trafalgar Releasing's BTS World Tour 'Arirang' in São Paulo live viewing took $2.8 million, placing sixth at the weekend box office.

item.title: A cyberattack takes down more than 80 Moldovan public service websites
item.description: Moldova took over 80 public service sites offline after a cyberattack, and about 750,000 people had personal data stolen.

item.title: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold slips to February 23, 2027
item.description: Square Enix moved the Evercold expansion from January to February 23, 2027, with early access from February 19 and pre-orders opening November 4.

item.title: Laika's Wildwood holds well with a 39% drop over Halloween
item.description: The stop-motion film Wildwood took $7.4 million in third place, falling only 39% after strong reviews and audience scores.

item.title: Five tech giants have over $3 trillion in future AI spending commitments
item.description: Bloomberg totaled disclosed leases, construction, energy and equipment commitments at Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and Oracle at more than $3 trillion.

item.title: Hackers had backend access to about 250,000 Sungrow solar systems in Germany
item.description: Die Zeit reports attackers could reach the backend controlling about 250,000 Sungrow solar systems, mostly on private homes.

item.title: A Sony job listing mentioning 'Intelligent Pricing' revives personalized-pricing worries
item.description: A PlayStation listing for a digital monetization director refers to 'Intelligent Pricing' and expanding 'Targeted Offers', prompting player concern.

item.title: Jailer 2 nears the all-time Tamil box office record in India
item.description: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has grossed about 777 crore rupees worldwide in 16 days and is within 10 crore of 2.0's Tamil record in India.

item.title: SemiAnalysis tests show AMD chips serving Kimi K3 for less than Nvidia's B200
item.description: SemiAnalysis benchmark data shows AMD's MI355X serving Moonshot's Kimi K3 model at up to 2.3 times lower cost per token than Nvidia's B200.

item.title: Memory chip makers outearn five big US tech firms for the first time
item.description: Nikkei reports five leading memory suppliers made more combined profit last quarter than five big US tech companies.

item.title: Paramount's Street Fighter film falls 63% in its third weekend
item.description: The Street Fighter movie took $3.2 million, the steepest drop in the top 10, as the game adaptation slid to fifth place.

item.title: Skyblivion mod team says a former volunteer is threatening to sue
item.description: The team remaking Oblivion inside Skyrim says an ex-volunteer is seeking over 30,000 euros, and it has removed that person's work.

item.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York jumps 1,284% as it goes wide
item.description: Noah Segan's crime thriller expanded to 1,112 theaters and took $1.9 million, the biggest gain on the weekend chart.

item.title: Nintendo marks Pikmin Day with a free Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition demo
item.description: A free demo of Pikmin 4's Switch 2 Edition arrives November 2, following a Pikmin Day Direct on November 1.

item.title: Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery merger brings a leadership reshuffle
item.description: The $110 billion Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery merger is reported to be bringing executive exits and new reporting lines.

item.title: The Elder Scrolls VI is reported to be called Sentinel, with a reveal in November
item.description: The Verge reports the next Elder Scrolls game is titled Sentinel and set in Hammerfell, with a title reveal possibly next month.

item.title: Instagram is reported to offer YouTubers up to $500,000 for long-form video
item.description: Business Insider reports Instagram is offering creators $50,000 to $500,000 to post horizontal videos to its Features format the same day they hit YouTube.
